name: Moonpool Docs
note: Offline Markdown docs browser hosting Moonpool's own help. {MP_HOME} resolves to this bundle's folder, so the tile travels with a zip/USB copy.

name: CSV Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for CSV/TSV. Auto-profiles any file and renders it; ships differently-shaped sample tabs. Runs offline, no server.

name: JSON Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for JSON (arrays, nested objects, or maps; nested keys flattened automatically).

name: JSONL Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for JSONL / NDJSON (one JSON record per line).

name: YAML Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for YAML, parsed offline with a vendored js-yaml.

name: TOML Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for TOML, parsed offline with a vendored j-toml.

name: Excel Explorer
note: Drop-your-data dashboard for Excel .xlsx / .xls workbooks, parsed offline with a vendored SheetJS.
